draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 89th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 8th of 30 at LB. He went 18th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (89th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing standouts: three-cone (97th percentile), broad jump (89th percentile). College production: his final season (2022) ranked 2nd in tackles among the 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions. 51 career games and 46 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (14 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: combined tackles 176 (99th percentile), sacks 5.0 (98th percentile), approximate value 14 (97th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 176 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
